import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem logb_three_pow (n : ℕ) : Real.logb (3 : ℝ) ((3 : ℝ) ^ n) = n := by
  have h₁ : Real.logb (3 : ℝ) ((3 : ℝ) ^ n) = n * Real.logb (3 : ℝ) (3 : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.logb, div_eq_mul_inv]
    
    simp [Real.log_rpow, Real.log_pow, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm]
    <;> ring_nf
    <;> field_simp [Real.log_mul, Real.log_rpow, Real.log_pow, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm]
    <;> norm_cast
    <;> simp_all [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_zero, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_sub]
    <;> field_simp [Real.log_mul, Real.log_rpow, Real.log_pow, mul_assoc, mul_comm, mul_left_comm]
    <;> ring_nf
    <;> norm_cast
  
  have h₂ : Real.logb (3 : ℝ) (3 : ℝ) = 1 := by
    have h₂₁ : Real.logb (3 : ℝ) (3 : ℝ) = 1 := by
      rw [Real.logb]
      
      field_simp [Real.log_ne_zero_of_pos_of_ne_one, show (0 : ℝ) < 3 by norm_num, show (3 : ℝ) ≠ 1 by norm_num]
      <;>
      ring_nf
      <;>
      simp_all [Real.log_ne_zero_of_pos_of_ne_one, Real.log_mul, Real.log_rpow, Real.log_pow]
      <;>
      field_simp [Real.log_ne_zero_of_pos_of_ne_one, show (0 : ℝ) < 3 by norm_num, show (3 : ℝ) ≠ 1 by norm_num]
      <;>
      ring_nf
    exact h₂₁
  
  have h₃ : Real.logb (3 : ℝ) ((3 : ℝ) ^ n) = n * 1 := by
    rw [h₁]
    rw [h₂]
    <;> ring
    <;> simp_all
    <;> field_simp
    <;> ring_nf
  
  have h₄ : Real.logb (3 : ℝ) ((3 : ℝ) ^ n) = n := by
    rw [h₃]
    <;> ring
    <;> simp_all
    <;> field_simp
    <;> ring_nf
  
  exact h₄
